overview.location: 5300 Riverside Dr, Cleveland, Ohio 44135 — on the city's southwest side next to Brook Park, about 10 miles southwest of downtown Cleveland (verify mileage).

overview.distinction: Ohio's busiest airport (verify). Owned by the City of Cleveland; widely cited as the first municipally owned airport in the U.S. (1925) and the first U.S. airport with a direct rail link to downtown (RTA Red Line, 1968) — verify both claims before stating as fact.
overview.operator: City of Cleveland, Department of Port Control
overview.totalConcourses: verify — Concourses A, B and C active; Concourse D closed (verify)
overview.dominantAirline: verify — no hub carrier (former United hub, de-hubbed 2014)

Trains every 15 minutes most of the day; under 30 minutes to downtown via Tower City Station. Source: clevelandairport.com public-transportation page.

groundTransportationCenter.description: Brown Lot shuttles drop off and pick up at the Ground Transportation Center (per clevelandairport.com). Crowne Plaza Airport Hotel tells guests to wait at Ground Transportation Bay #7.
groundTransportationCenter.note: Exact bay assignments for other shuttles, rideshare and taxis — verify on clevelandairport.com.

taxi.note: Taxi details not confirmed from clevelandairport.com (taxi/rideshare page returned 404 on 2026-10-16).

rideshare.note: Third-party sources say drivers stage in the cell phone lot off Jackson Road; confirm the current pickup spot in the app.

rentalCars.location: verify — CLE uses an off-terminal consolidated rental car facility reached by shuttle (verify address and pickup)

groundTransportation.hotelShuttles: Hotel courtesy shuttles pick up at the Ground Transportation Center (verify bay). Crowne Plaza Airport Hotel specifies Ground Transportation Bay #7 only. CLE Park picks up on the ticketing level, not baggage claim. Airport Express Parking tells guests to call on landing because its pickup spot can change month to month.

parkingRates: On-airport (per day): Brown Lot $15 ($13 reserved online), Orange Lot $21, Blue Lot $24, Smart Parking Garage $26 ($7/hr), Premium Reserved Red Lot $29 (reservation only), Curbside Valet $37. Credit cards only. Off-site via Triply: four shuttle lots in Cleveland, Brook Park and Middleburg Heights from ~$7.61/day.

brownLot.location: 4960 Rocky River Drive, north of the I-480 underpass at Rocky River Drive and Brookpark Road
brownLot.connection: Shuttle every ~15 minutes to/from the Ground Transportation Center

orangeLot.name: CLE Orange Lot
orangeLot.location: Across Park Road from the Smart Garage (turn left from Inner Drive onto Park Road before the baggage deck)
orangeLot.connection: Skywalk to the Smart Garage; covered access to the terminal

blueLot.name: CLE Blue Lot

premiumReservedRedLot.name: CLE Premium Reserved Red Lot
premiumReservedRedLot.features: Reservation only. Covered parking with covered walkway to the terminal, directly north of the terminal across from the Blue Lot. Showed "Full" on 2026-10-16.

onAirportParking.accessibleParking: Not described on clevelandairport.com parking pages — verify with the parking operator.
onAirportParking.paymentMethods: Credit cards only at all airport lots. Brown Lot, Smart Garage and Red Lot can be reserved online.
onAirportParking.garageServiceAreas: Smart Garage, Orange, Blue and Red lots: walk to terminal. Brown Lot: shuttle.

parkingLots.name: 2 Birds Shuttle and Detail
parkingLots.sampleQuote: $64.61 total for Nov 2-9, 2026 (8 billing days) incl. $2.90 fees + $3.71 tax; same on Nov 9-16 and Nov 16-23
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 4 AM-1 AM every 30 minutes (10 and 40 past the hour) to the airport; airport pickups on demand. No shuttle 1 AM-4 AM. Call 216-905-3680 for entrance to the lot; you get a card with return-shuttle info.
parkingLots.overview: Fenced lot with security personnel and cameras about 3 miles from CLE on W 150th St. Free shuttle included with online purchase. Cheapest sellable lot at CLE.
parkingLots.notes: Minimum booking 4 days. Free shuttle covers max 3 people per reservation; extra riders $25 payable at the lot (drop the party at the terminal first to avoid it). Arrive before the 2-hour pre-flight window.

parkingLots.name: Crowne Plaza Airport Hotel
parkingLots.sampleQuote: $79.97 total for Nov 2-9 and Nov 9-16, 2026 (8 billing days); $83.13 for Nov 16-23
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 4 AM-midnight every 30 minutes (on the hour and half hour). No shuttle midnight-4 AM. Call the hotel to reserve a shuttle seat at least 2 hours before arrival. On return, call 440-243-4040 after collecting bags; pickup at Ground Transportation Bay #7 only.
parkingLots.overview: Hotel park-and-fly lot about 7 minutes' drive from CLE in Middleburg Heights, with security camera monitoring, marked handicap-accessible spaces and an accessible shuttle on advance notice.
parkingLots.notes: Check in at the front desk before parking. Return pickup is Ground Transportation Bay #7 only. No overnight shuttle (12-4 AM).

parkingLots.name: Airport Express Parking
parkingLots.sampleQuote: $112.08 total for Nov 2-9, 9-16 and 16-23, 2026 (8 billing days)
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: Shuttles to the airport start at 4 AM (no earlier) until the last flight; shuttles from the airport 24/7 as needed. Call 216-212-2727 after you have your bags — the pickup location can change month to month. Call 30 minutes ahead for same-day bookings or flight changes.
parkingLots.overview: Closest Triply lot to CLE on Brookpark Road. Open 24/7 with free shuttle on every online purchase, security cameras and gated/fenced parking. No extra charge for full-size vans, pickup trucks and large SUVs.
parkingLots.notes: Minimum booking 5 days. Daily rate is close to the Brown Lot's $13 reserved / $15 drive-up rate — sell on the 24/7 return shuttle and oversize-vehicle policy, not on price vs Brown Lot.

parkingLots.name: CLE Park
parkingLots.sampleQuote: $113.04 total for Nov 2-9, 9-16 and 16-23, 2026 (8 billing days)
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: Check-in shuttles start at 4 AM (no earlier); check-out shuttles 24/7 as needed. Call 216-870-4100 when you have your bags. Airport pickup is on the TICKETING level, not baggage claim. Pull up to the gate and call the number on it to be let in.
parkingLots.overview: Lot on Engle Road in Brook Park about 1.6 miles from CLE, open 24 hours with a free shuttle to and from the airport.
parkingLots.notes: Minimum booking 5 days. Not the airport's own lot despite the name. Daily rate is close to the Brown Lot's $13-15 — sell on the 24/7 return shuttle, not on price vs Brown Lot.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: Brown Lot shuttle every ~15 minutes to the Ground Transportation Center; all other airport lots are walk-in. Off-site Triply lots: Airport Express Parking and CLE Park run return shuttles 24/7 (outbound from 4 AM); 2 Birds runs 4 AM-1 AM; Crowne Plaza runs 4 AM-midnight and returns from Ground Transportation Bay #7. CLE Park picks up on the ticketing level. No Triply lot runs outbound shuttles before 4 AM.
distanceFromCity: About 10 miles southwest of downtown Cleveland via I-71 (verify mileage); RTA Red Line under 30 minutes to Tower City.

keyDistances.toDowntownCleveland: ~10 miles by car (verify); RTA Red Line <30 min
keyDistances.toBrookPark: ~1.5 miles (Triply lots: Airport Express Parking, CLE Park)
keyDistances.toMiddleburgHeights: ~3 miles (Triply lot: Crowne Plaza Airport Hotel)
keyDistances.toW150thSt: ~3 miles (Triply lot: 2 Birds Shuttle and Detail)
keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: All four Triply CLE lots are 1.4-3.1 miles from the terminal; two run return shuttles 24/7. The two cheapest (2 Birds ~$7.61/day, Crowne Plaza ~$9.29/day) undercut even the $13-15 Brown Lot.
